notes: A guided setup checks a new project's files step by step before the first load, and lithology can come from several files. Projects can work in US customary units throughout. The Model Builder handles oxidation zones and mineral types, sets reach and classification from holes it has not seen, estimates by-products and stress-tests each decision. GIS layers take map-sheet patterns and colour files, Geosoft grids load directly, and files can be dragged in from Explorer or Finder.
